title: Hefty,Hefty,Hefty!
text:
Hefty,Hefty,Hefty!. I was not expecting this to be so thick...I bought the flimsiest duvet insert I could find and this turned in
to a furnace. It wrinkles like the dickens when you wash it~I actually ironed the darn thing the first time
I used it so it wouldn't look so shabby. Maybe it'll soften up after a couple dozen washes,meantime I've
used it as is. I got it because it matches the rug and curtains in my room. I should've sent it back. Maybe it'll make up for all this come winter time. Ugh.

product_metadata.title: Amazon Brand – Pinzon 300 Thread Count 100% Cotton Percale Duvet Cover Set - Twin, Platinum
features: Percale is known for its crisp hand feel, and matte finish. More durable than sateen, it starts off a little stiff, but continues to softens after each wash.
The 300 thread count weave is breatheable and cool to the touch, making it ideal for warm climates or summer months.
Duvet cover set includes twin-size duvet cover and 1 matching pillow sham; Internal duvet ties to keep your duvet from shifting
Solid color with stylish lattice design; matches with our Pinzon 300-Thread-Count Percale Sheet Set
Duvet cover measures 68 x 88 inches and pillow sham measures 20 x 26 inches; machine washable and tumble dry for easy cleaning as needed
Made in OEKO-TEX Standard 100 factory, an independent certification system that ensures textiles meet high safety and environmental standards.
